title: Continuous evidence-first bug mining
focus: Rotate current diff, history, tests, fuzzing, sanitizers, static analysis, coverage, performance, platform, and external evidence to find and prove distinct defects.

title: Source comment versus implementation contract audit
focus: Compare nontrivial comments with code, callers, tests, docs, blame, and historical rationale; correct only a proven stale contract or implementation.

title: Assertion, Assume, and invariant reachability audit
focus: Trace assertions and assumptions through release, fuzz, RPC, network, persisted-data, and optional-module paths; prove invalid assumptions or missing validation.

title: Current branch and PR leftover sweep
focus: Search each current commit for analogous sites, stale names, partial migrations, omitted tests, generated files, build lists, and unresolved review objections.

title: Public API, CLI, RPC, config, and help contract audit
focus: Compare registration, parsing, types, defaults, help, errors, runtime behavior, persistence, restart behavior, docs, tests, and compatibility.

title: Boundary-condition and off-by-one audit
focus: Formalize domains and test below, at, and above boundaries for heights, times, amounts, counts, offsets, limits, encodings, and iterator ranges.

title: Serialization, deserialization, and untrusted-input sweep
focus: Trace untrusted bytes through lengths, allocations, casts, loops, mutation, canonical encodings, output state, and later assumptions.

title: Untrusted-interface resource-exhaustion variant analysis
focus: Mine DoS shapes and calculate explicit CPU, memory, disk, network, descriptor, queue, retry, and retained-state bounds for realistic inputs.

title: Locking, threading, and scheduler audit
focus: Map locks, atomics, condition variables, callbacks, worker shutdown, lifetimes, lock order, and deterministic race schedules; prove first conflicting accesses.

title: Hit-frequency and suspicious-branch coverage audit
focus: Rank rarely executed branches by security, state mutation, complexity, error handling, persistence, secret handling, and untrusted-input proximity.

title: Fuzz-target gap and harness-realism audit
focus: Compare production entry points with fuzz reachability, dynamic coverage, state realism, error handling, and oracle quality; add deterministic high-value harness coverage.

title: Sanitizer and Valgrind true-positive sweep
focus: Run ASan, UBSan, TSan, MSan, LeakSanitizer, Valgrind, and sanitized fuzz/recovery workloads; minimize first invalid operations and reject broad suppressions.

title: Static-analysis true-positive campaign
focus: Use compiler warnings, clang analysis, clang-tidy, CodeQL or Semgrep, IWYU, and semantic queries to prove lifetime, overflow, result, lock, and control-flow defects.

title: Secret-data lifetime and zeroization audit
focus: Trace private keys, nonces, seeds, tweaks, passphrases, and secret-derived temporaries through copies, moves, errors, callbacks, logs, destructors, and optimized clearing.

title: Secret-dependent control-flow and memory-access audit
focus: Trace secret taint into branches, loop counts, indexes, addresses, helper choices, error paths, compiler output, ctgrind, dudect, and explicit declassification boundaries.

title: Public object parsing and validation variant analysis
focus: Compare all equivalent parsing paths for keys, signatures, scalars, scripts, descriptors, records, addresses, and wrappers across malformed and noncanonical inputs.

title: Public API misuse-resistance audit
focus: Read headers, examples, bindings, tests, and implementation as an adversarial caller; test ownership, lifetime, capability, callbacks, invalidation, status, and failure outputs.

title: Build-matrix and module-configuration audit
focus: Enumerate compilers, features, wallets, IPC, GUI, tools, fuzz, assembly, exhaustive, shared/static, cross, and sanitizer configurations and their interactions.

title: Exhaustive and algebraic-invariant audit
focus: State identities for parsing, arithmetic, normalization, signing, storage, iteration, cache recomputation, and recovery; test exhaustive small domains and randomized properties.

title: Benchmark correctness and measurement-integrity audit
focus: Audit benchmark setup, timed regions, units, inputs, caches, I/O, compiler-elision barriers, result validation, repetitions, noise, and profile attribution.

title: Simple micro-optimization discovery and proof
focus: Use profiles to select one narrow hot operation, then prove a simple allocation, copy, lookup, hashing, branch, serialization, or lock improvement with interleaved measurements.

title: Long-running rebuild, recovery, and compaction profiling
focus: Profile rebuild, reindex, rescan, recovery, snapshot, index, and compaction workloads with CPU, I/O, memory, fsync, progress, and correctness evidence.

title: Full sync, IBD, import, and end-to-end profiling
focus: Measure controlled sync/import/reindex phases while separating download, validation, scripts, crypto, chainstate, block I/O, compaction, logging, and network time.

title: Perf and flamegraph investigation without forced commits
focus: Capture perf, flamegraphs, scheduler, lock, CPU counter, memory, disk, network, and process data; leave measured hypotheses and raw artifacts even without a code change.

title: Disk I/O, persistence growth, and write-amplification audit
focus: Measure reads, writes, fsyncs, compactions, logs, temporary files, database growth, cache bypasses, repeated serialization, and crash-consistent storage placement.

title: Recent performance-regression bisect
focus: Compare stable workloads across a justified commit range, bisect a proven regression, explain changed work or resource behavior, and preserve correctness intent.

title: Bug fixed in one subsystem but present in another
focus: Mine historical fixes for structural bug shapes and search analogous parsers, caches, indexes, queues, state machines, and APIs with reachability proof.

title: Error-path partial-state mutation audit
focus: Enumerate all failure edges of status/result/exception APIs and compare complete pre/post object, cache, file, transaction, index, and retry state.

title: Weak-test oracle and mutation-survival audit
focus: Find no-op, success-only, log-only, duplicate-logic, sleep-based, and missing-negative tests; use targeted mutations and add the smallest behavior-sensitive oracle.

title: Dead code, stale feature, and TODO archaeology
focus: Inventory unreachable code, dormant flags, obsolete compatibility, duplicated implementations, stale tests/docs, and TODOs; prove intentional debt versus safe removal.

title: Security-sensitive and misleading logging audit
focus: Trace secrets, private metadata, peer identifiers, wallet details, paths, configuration, raw payloads, severity, escaping, repetition, and diagnostic truthfulness into logs.

title: Cross-layer docs, examples, tests, and implementation audit
focus: Build a contract table across source, public docs, examples, schemas, help, release notes, tests, and implementation; fix the smallest traceable mismatch.

title: Whole-history incomplete-fix and migration mining
focus: Mine historical partial fixes, follow-ups, reverted work, and migrations; locate omitted analogous sites, stale compatibility, and unresolved assumptions on current code.

title: External vulnerability and advisory variant analysis
focus: Use advisories and related-project fixes as seeds, map their preconditions to this tree, independently verify applicability, and produce report-ready evidence for remote-only defects.

title: Uncovered-code classification and closure audit
focus: Classify uncovered code as legitimate platform/config, harness gap, dead code, or risky behavior; close only high-value gaps with semantic tests and measured coverage.

title: Mutation-testing campaign
focus: Run focused source or LLVM-level mutations across security, consensus, persistence, crypto, networking, and recent fixes; kill realistic defects with minimal tests.

title: Cross-tool sanitizer and static-analysis matrix
focus: Run complementary sanitizer and analyzer combinations across modules and configurations, correlate reports, and separate root causes from instrumentation or suppression artifacts.

title: Build dead-zone and conditional-compilation audit
focus: Find code, tests, generated files, and security paths hidden by feature flags, platform guards, compiler checks, or conditional source lists; execute or justify each zone.

title: Failure cleanup and crash-safety audit
focus: Inject errors and abrupt exits through allocation, I/O, callbacks, locks, database, network, and parsing paths; prove cleanup, rollback, retry, and restart invariants.

title: Generated-artifact and test-vector determinism audit
focus: Audit generated code, fixtures, vectors, ordering, timestamps, locale, randomness, tool versions, and regeneration rules for reproducibility and stale output.

title: Independent multi-agent disagreement and adjudication audit
focus: Have independent investigators analyze the same candidate or surface, compare evidence and assumptions, adjudicate disagreement, and retain dissent with a final verifier verdict.

title: History archaeology from a seed topic
focus: Start from one bug shape, symbol, issue, or review topic and follow blame, merges, branches, reverts, tests, and later variants to generate evidence-backed current hypotheses.

title: CI, coverage-bot, and review-bot follow-up audit
focus: Mine CI failures, coverage comments, analyzer reports, review bots, and unresolved checks for real omissions, stale suppressions, and follow-up fixes.

title: Option and API lifecycle audit
focus: Trace creation, defaulting, mutation, runtime observation, reload, persistence, restart, deprecation, and removal of options and APIs across all clients.

title: Secret-copy and compiler-optimization audit
focus: Find avoidable secret copies and compiler transformations that retain or expose them; inspect optimized code, cleanse primitives, moves, buffers, and failure paths.

title: Constant-time boundary and declassification audit
focus: Define secret/public transitions around crypto and authentication APIs, then prove constant-time obligations, public-dependent exceptions, and declassification justifications.

title: Public API output-on-failure audit
focus: Exercise malformed and failing public calls to determine whether outputs are unchanged, zeroed, invalidated, or partially committed as documented and expected by callers.

title: Build-system and CI parity audit
focus: Compare local build recipes, CI jobs, release builds, test matrices, generated manifests, cache keys, feature flags, and toolchain assumptions for missing coverage.

title: Property, exhaustive, and algebraic oracle expansion
focus: Expand weak example tests into properties, exhaustive small domains, differential references, metamorphic relations, failure-state postconditions, and minimized counterexamples.

title: Critical whole-history must-fix sweep
focus: Search all historical critical fixes and security-sensitive follow-ups for current variants, backports, reverts, and untested assumptions; verify only concrete reachable omissions.

title: Fuzz Introspector blocker and complexity audit
focus: Use static reachability, dynamic coverage, complexity ranking, call-depth and blocker data to explain why high-risk fuzz targets are ineffective and remove real blockers.

title: Invariant, differential, and metamorphic audit
focus: Define state and output invariants, compare alternative implementations and transformations, and use sequence-based metamorphic testing to find inconsistent behavior.

title: Integer overflow, narrowing, signedness, and division audit
focus: Trace widths and arithmetic around casts, shifts, division, sentinels, sizes, fees, amounts, counts, and serialization under 32- and 64-bit relevant domains.

title: Statistical timing-side-channel campaign
focus: Measure secret-class timing with controlled dudect-style experiments, compiler/backend variants, noise analysis, and dataflow review while treating passing statistics as limited evidence.

title: RAII, smart-pointer, and resource-leak audit
focus: Audit ownership, moves, exception/error paths, custom deleters, file descriptors, locks, threads, mappings, database handles, and callbacks for leaks and lifetime errors.

title: Alternative-implementation compatibility-difference audit
focus: Compare protocol, crypto, database, and wrapper behavior with related implementations, classify intentional policy differences, and prove local contract or compatibility defects.

title: Stale PR critical-fix resurrection audit
focus: Mine abandoned or stale pull requests for reproducible security, correctness, testing, portability, or performance fixes, rebase intent carefully, and verify against current code.

title: Local-reasoning domain and relationship audit
focus: Challenge functions whose local assumptions omit callers, domains, relationships, ownership, ordering, or state transitions; prove the smallest missing precondition or invariant.

title: Exact helper reuse and minimal helper-extension audit
focus: Find duplicated near-equivalent helpers and determine whether exact reuse, a narrow extension, or intentional separation is required by contracts, performance, or constant-time rules.

title: C/C++ supply-chain and security-gate audit
focus: Audit dependencies, vendored code, build downloads, compiler tools, hashes, signatures, license gates, generated inputs, and security checks for practical supply-chain weaknesses.

title: Historical reviewer-preference mining and reusable review skill
focus: Extract technically grounded reviewer patterns, rejected approaches, test expectations, and architecture rules from history; validate reusable review recipes on held-out changes.

title: Stateful contract-fuzzer expansion
focus: Build production-backed operation-sequence fuzzers for stateful APIs, with model invariants, failure-state checks, deterministic shrinking, and minimized replayable sequences.

title: Rejected-finding resurrection and assumption attack
focus: Revisit dismissed findings and their assumptions, attack changed callers, configurations, versions, and input domains, and either confirm recurrence or preserve the dismissal rationale.

title: Loupe-style scout, verifier, fixer, and reporter pipeline
focus: Separate scouting, independent verification, fixing, and reporting with leases, regression PoCs, applicability checks, deduplication, and final review evidence.

title: Finding deduplication, recurrence, and semantic-fingerprint audit
focus: Index findings by path, trust boundary, shape, source-to-sink relation, versions, hashes, and semantics; detect duplicates, recurrences, incomplete variants, and regressions.

title: Contributor-branch and work-in-progress radar
focus: Inventory public contributor branches, PRs, bases, divergence, tests, review concerns, upcoming migrations, useful seeds, independent bugs, and conflict risks without copying unpublished work.

title: Cherry-pick, backport, and release-branch correctness audit
focus: Compare patch intent and behavior across maintenance branches, prerequisite chains, conflict resolutions, generated files, guards, tests, and upgrade/downgrade paths.

title: Release-to-release behavioral and consensus differential
focus: Feed identical deterministic vectors, blocks, transactions, scripts, wallets, databases, RPC cases, and transcripts to releases and current HEAD; classify expected drift.

title: Architecture, endianness, word-size, and ABI parity audit
focus: Compare supported architectures, widths, alignment, endian conversions, atomics, filesystem and socket APIs, serialized outputs, assembly selection, and skipped tests.

title: SIMD, assembly, and portable-reference backend differential
focus: Force optimized and reference backends for hashing, crypto, field/scalar/group math, checksums, memory, and codecs; compare outputs, errors, aliasing, and timing contracts.

title: Compiler, optimization, LTO, PGO, and BOLT differential
focus: Compare supported compilers and optimization/profile modes for correctness, UB, miscompiles, barriers, constant-time behavior, size, startup, cache, and reproducible performance.

title: Deterministic simulation and failure-schedule exploration
focus: Explore seeded task ordering, time, randomness, network, disk, retries, and shutdown schedules through production logic with explicit state, progress, durability, and resource invariants.

title: Filesystem, power-loss, and crash-consistency injection
focus: Inject short writes, ENOSPC, EIO, drops, corruption, truncation, reorder assumptions, and process kills around durable boundaries; verify restart and idempotent recovery.

title: Network fragmentation, reordering, and partial-I/O state-machine audit
focus: Exercise fragmented and coalesced reads, short writes, EOF, reconnects, half-closes, stalls, backpressure, duplicate messages, and handshake state with deterministic socket shims.

title: Memory pressure, OOM, allocator, and fragmentation audit
focus: Measure heap, RSS, allocation lifetime, fragmentation, caches, arenas, and stack under normal and adversarial workloads; inject OOM and verify bounded graceful failure.

title: Build throughput, dependency graph, and container-cache audit
focus: Measure clean, incremental, no-op, parallel, and container builds for dependency fan-out, generated instability, header cost, serialized commands, and cache correctness.

title: Reproducible binaries, Guix, and toolchain-provenance audit
focus: Rebuild artifacts in pinned clean environments and compare hashes and binary differences; trace timestamps, paths, ordering, dependencies, signing, and host contamination.

title: Symbolic execution and bounded-model-checking campaign
focus: Apply CBMC or KLEE to bounded high-risk kernels with explicit production assumptions, memory/UB assertions, reference equivalence, postconditions, and replayable counterexamples.

title: Compiler-transformation validation and miscompile isolation
focus: Compare LLVM IR and optimized results with Alive2, compiler versions, UB-free reducers, and deterministic vectors to isolate source UB, compiler bugs, assembly contracts, or test errors.

title: Fuzz-corpus stewardship, minimization, and transfer audit
focus: Inventory corpora, coverage, size, runtime, provenance, and crashes; minimize and transfer structurally useful inputs across targets and engines without losing semantics.

title: Fuzz-engine and property-framework differential
focus: Compare libFuzzer, AFL++, Honggfuzz, and property-based fuzzing on shared targets, seeds, budgets, coverage, execution rate, crashes, memory, and corpus quality.

title: Specification, test-vector, and formal-model drift audit
focus: Map implementation and tests to authoritative BIPs, protocol documents, secp docs, formal models, and versioned vectors; resolve drift with traceable provenance.

title: secp256k1 field and scalar representation matrix
focus: Compare 5x52/10x26 fields, 4x64/8x32 scalars, VERIFY, exhaustive, inversion, compiler, and architecture paths with limb, carry, magnitude, aliasing, and boundary properties.

title: secp256k1 group, ecmult, and formula-parity audit
focus: Compare affine/Jacobian formulas, infinity, wNAF, windows, generator/arbitrary multiplication, endomorphism, batch inversion, optimized paths, and exhaustive/reference results.

title: secp256k1 nonce, signing, Schnorr, and MuSig state-machine audit
focus: Model signing, nonce, tweak, ECDH, extrakeys, and MuSig transitions; test invalid order, reuse, duplicates, malformed values, callbacks, replay, and output-on-failure.

title: Bitcoin consensus mutation-score and kill-test audit
focus: Mutate consensus checks, activation boundaries, flags, script limits, canonical forms, cache keys, amount/sequence/time arithmetic, and prove tests distinguish each non-equivalent mutant.

title: Bitcoin chainstate, reorg, prune, and index crash-symmetry audit
focus: Model connect/disconnect, flush, reorg, restart, prune, snapshots, block/undo files, and indexes; inject crashes and assert durable-state and query symmetry.

title: Bitcoin mempool, package, and eviction-accounting audit
focus: Model acceptance, replacement, ancestor/descendant graphs, fees, clusters, expiry, trimming, conflicts, reorg removal, and memory accounting under operation sequences.

title: Bitcoin wallet encryption, backup, descriptor, and keypool recovery audit
focus: Trace wallet encryption, passphrase changes, master keys, descriptors, keypool, reservation, migration, backup, restore, rescan, signers, failures, and restart durability.

title: Bitcoin P2P transport, permission, and peer-accounting audit
focus: Model peer lifecycle, v1/v2 transport, permissions, handshake, messages, quotas, discouragement, download state, queues, timeouts, and disconnect cleanup under partial I/O.

title: Whole-PR and commit knowledge-base recipe synthesis
focus: Extract reusable technical recipes from commits and PRs: invariants, bug shapes, rejected designs, benchmarks, fixtures, platform caveats, migrations, and follow-ups.

title: Compiler and binary-hardening configuration audit
focus: Audit warnings, stack protection, FORTIFY, PIE, RELRO, CFI, SafeStack, control-flow protections, assertions, sanitizers, and final binaries for concrete security value.

title: ABI layout, alignment, aliasing, and object-lifetime audit
focus: Test packed layouts, unions, casts, placement new, raw storage, over-alignment, strict aliasing, pointer provenance, lifetimes, and C/C++ ABI across compilers and hosts.

title: Allocation, syscall, clock, randomness, and callback fault injection
focus: Fail allocations, opens, reads, writes, fsync, rename, sockets, threads, entropy, clocks, scheduler callbacks, databases, and user callbacks at deterministic operation counts.

title: Bindings, FFI, and language-wrapper parity audit
focus: Compare C/C++ APIs with maintained wrappers for widths, ownership, lifetimes, nullability, callbacks, exceptions, buffers, secrets, threads, flags, and malformed inputs.

title: Database-engine and persistence-semantics differential
focus: Compare LevelDB assumptions with upstream and alternative engines for ordering, snapshots, iterators, batches, WAL/MANIFEST, checksums, filters, compaction, and recovery.

title: TODO, FIXME, stub, and deferred-work challenge audit
focus: Turn deferred-work markers, disabled tests, expected failures, stubs, compatibility code, and placeholders into current falsifiable questions with history and ownership.

title: C and C++ defect-taxonomy sweep
focus: Cycle through null, arithmetic, lifetime, bounds, race, deadlock, aliasing, cleanup, recursion, format, and unchecked-result defects using tools plus real reachability proof.

title: Floating-point edge values, sanitizer resurrection, and fuzz-exclusion audit
focus: Test exceptional floating values, revive suppressed sanitizer diagnostics, and challenge fuzzer exclusions while preserving legitimate preconditions and failure-state safety.

title: PSBT serialized-key identity and round-trip preservation audit
focus: Compare PSBT map key identity with in-memory equality and ordering for every keydata-bearing field; mutate one serialized byte at a time, test parse/merge/RPC/re-encode preservation, and distinguish exact duplicates from distinct valid records.

title: Append-only preallocation and physical/logical file-size audit
focus: Audit preallocation, truncation, flush, rebuild, and recovery helpers when physical file size exceeds logical position; force unsupported-platform fallbacks, preserve existing bytes, test overflow and short writes, and compare Windows, macOS, POSIX, sparse, and crash-recovery semantics.

title: Minisketch runtime implementation dispatch and availability audit
focus: Exercise compile-time CLMUL inclusion and runtime CPU-feature selection across supported and unsupported CPUs; verify implementation_supported/create consistency, safe generic fallback, CPUID and OS assumptions, disabled-field matrices, and diagnostics without executing unsupported instructions.

title: macOS preallocation and physical/logical file-size semantics audit
focus: Audit the __APPLE__ F_PREALLOCATE and ftruncate path for existing-file shrinkage, fallback-result handling, off_t overflow, sparse and exFAT behavior, short writes, crashes, and restart/reindex preservation with platform tests or faithful models.

title: X-only conversion precondition and invalid CPubKey boundary audit
focus: Audit every XOnlyPubKey(CPubKey) caller for empty, short, syntactically valid, and off-curve inputs; prove safe preconditions across descriptors, signing, providers, wallet, fuzz, and serialization without changing raw script consensus semantics; add focused guards or contract tests only for confirmed failures.

title: Integer option narrowing and resource-boundary audit
focus: Audit int64_t-to-int, size_t, chrono, and signed/unsigned conversions in startup and resource options; model representability, negative values, downstream arithmetic, and OS caps for -par, duration options, wallet fee sizes, and index heights with sanitizer and clean-startup evidence.

title: Minisketch API size and count arithmetic audit
focus: Audit Minisketch serialized-size multiplication, capacity/max-elements computations, decode return counts, and C/C++ output bounds for size_t overflow, allocation-feasible extremes, and cross-backend consistency with boundary models and sanitized API probes.

title: Generated-source escaping and provenance boundary audit
focus: Audit generators that turn external or mutable text/data into C/C++, Rust, shell, manpage, build, or metadata artifacts for delimiter escaping, comment and literal closure, paths, command arguments, encoding, size limits, provenance, determinism, and fail-closed behavior with hostile fixtures and consumer compilation.

title: BIP324 short-message ID and long-form interoperability audit
focus: Extract authoritative BIP324 and extension ID tables, compare Core and alternate implementations in both directions, require supported messages to accept short and long forms, reject unassigned IDs consistently, test feature negotiation and version gating, and preserve deterministic wire fixtures for every discrepancy.

title: Persisted GCS filter payload validation and recovery audit
focus: Audit block-filter index flat-file and database coupling, semantic validation skipped on local reads, malformed N/truncated/excess Golomb-Rice payloads, hash/position mismatches, startup and query recovery, and corruption classification; use coupled scratch fixtures, deterministic fault injection, bounded-work proofs, and independent restart/query oracles without duplicating network filter parsing.

title: libbitcoinkernel C ABI nullability, callback, and width matrix
focus: Compare the raw libbitcoinkernel C API with its C++ btck wrapper and header contracts for nullable arrays and output handles, borrowed lifetimes, callback ownership and reentrancy, status versus exception translation, length-delimited buffers, enum domains, and size_t or fixed-width conversions; use deterministic raw-C consumers, wrapper side-by-side tests, fault injection, and 32-bit or compile-time evidence to prove distinct mismatches.

title: Extended public-key identity across descriptor and wallet containers
focus: Audit CExtPubKey identity across descriptor extraction, gethdkeys, createwalletdescriptor, backup, migration, and PSBT. Compare cryptographic derivation equivalence with serialized metadata (version, depth, fingerprint, child, chain code, and public key), prove intentional deduplication, and test xpub/xprv and origin output under metadata collisions with explicit comparators and recurrence fixtures.

title: Kernel library and chainstate configuration parity audit
focus: Audit the CMake relationship among BUILD_KERNEL_LIB, BUILD_UTIL_CHAINSTATE, BUILD_KERNEL_TEST, functional-test capability flags, install components, pkg-config/header exports, Windows presets, cross builds, reduced exports, and fuzz overrides. For every supported cell prove target membership, generated metadata, dependency closure, and truthful enablement; use configure-only matrices when compilation is too expensive, and fix only mismatches that can be reproduced with exact cache values and target or install evidence.

title: Differential and varint formatter input-boundary audit
focus: Audit custom DifferenceFormatter, CompactSize, varint, and related vector formatters at public P2P, RPC, file, and persisted-state boundaries. Compare declared counts with representable element domains, allocation timing, arithmetic overflow, partial output, retry or penalty behavior, valid maximum cardinality, and malformed-input accounting across every caller. Use count-only malformed fixtures, independent old/new probes, boundary round trips, sanitizer or allocation evidence, history and recurrence searches, and exact caller contracts; avoid repeating repaired GETBLOCKTXN unless a different formatter or failure mode is proven.

title: BIP32 seed-length contract and caller parity audit
focus: Audit CExtKey::SetSeed and every wallet, descriptor, fuzz, binding, and release-branch caller against the BIP32 128--512-bit seed contract. Exercise empty, 15, 16, 32, 64, and 65-byte inputs; compare valid-key creation, assertion or error translation, output state, entropy assumptions, zeroization, and wrapper behavior across current and maintained releases. Use source-matched old/new tests, caller/dataflow traces, 32-bit or binding evidence where available, and recurrence fixtures; do not repeat the repaired SetSeed production change without a distinct caller or failure-mode mismatch.

title: Taproot satisfaction and wallet fee-bound differential
focus: Differentially audit tr() and rawtr() satisfaction-size bounds from descriptor parsing through wallet input/vsize/fee and PSBT or external signing. Enumerate keypath versus every scriptpath, leaf script and control-block compact-size prefixes, Merkle depths, Miniscript and multi_a stack counts, maximum-signature policy, multipath expansion, unknown tree metadata, and actual serialized witnesses. Compare descriptor formulas with independent signed-witness and full-transaction size oracles under boundary trees, nested braces, large scripts, duplicate leaves, and unavailable keys; reproduce historical workarounds, require no underestimation, and preserve unknown contracts rather than guessing.
